stories.title: Alun School in Mold to stay shut to pupils on Tuesday
stories.summary: Alun School in Mold will be closed to pupils again on Tuesday because the school has no gas supply. The school shut on Monday because of a fault with its central heating system. stories.title: Welsh Government publishes new National Strategy for Unpaid Carers with seven priorities
stories.summary: A new Welsh Government strategy published today sets out what councils, health boards, schools and employers are expected to do for people who look after a family member or friend without pay. stories.title: Flintshire schools are mark Odd Socks Day as Anti-Bullying Week begins
stories.summary: Many schools across Flintshire are taking part in Odd Socks Day today to start Anti-Bullying Week 2026, Flintshire County Council has said. stories.title: North Wales Police launch Operation Sceptre week in Flintshire North
stories.summary: Police are collecting unwanted knives at pop-up stops in Holywell, Bagillt, Flint and Deeside today as part of a national week of action on knife crime. stories.title: New Ofcom rules require more sites to detect and remove child sexual abuse material
stories.summary: Websites and apps will have to ban users who share child sexual abuse images and do more to find and remove them, under new rules set out today by Ofcom.
